thread:
lee: Heads-up—noticed tenant Y has +200 "active" streams for hours. Dashboard shows session_map size, but traces show many have zero sockets.

ana: Sounds like stale session entries. Did anyone change resume logic in the sticky-route rollout?

dev-bot: autotag: rollout=sticky-route-v2 user=infra-team

gabe: Quick log snippet: 
```
2026-03-21T09:02:10Z INFO socket closed conn=7f8 sess=s-42
2026-03-21T09:02:12Z WARN session not gc sess=s-42
2026-03-21T09:02:20Z INFO resume accepted sess=s-42 client=mobile-11
```

lee: Close then resume but stale entry never GC'd. That makes billing look higher. Can we tombstone stale sessions and return Retry-After so clients back off?

ana: +1. Proposal: feature-flag tombstone state, tombstone TTL=60s, header `Retry-After: 60` and metric `sessions.tombstone`. Can canary in dev.

gabe: Caveat: some mobile SDKs ignore Retry-After. Recommend adding `X-Evicted-Reason` and log `RESUME_POST_TOMBSTONE` so we can measure. Also warn dashboard about "probable stale entries".

lee: Sounds good. Action: gabe open PR with flag + headers, ana add dashboard badge and an alert for tombstone rate. Will canary and monitor billing meter.
